comment: Baseline: K=3 Gaussian on rolling-200 drawdown, mu-sort labelling. From regime_drawdown_2022.org.
Proposal: K=3 full-Sigma MVN on (r,vol5,dd200), NH-HMM softmax(VIX). Return-sort labelling.
Phase2 robustness: exp_002 with diagonal Sigma. Do cross-channel covariance terms earn their keep?
Phase2 robustness: exp_002 at K=4. Does a 4th state earn under misclassification? thirds-bucket labels.
Phase3: exp_004 + drawdown-sort labels (order_channel=2). Pin bear to deep-drawdown state; targets 2018.
Phase3: exp_004 + one-sided relu(VIX) transition gate. Calm days revert to sticky intercept; targets COVID/bull20.
Phase3 (BL-001): exp_004 + identity-pinned state->label map (cold-start, reused on warm refits). Kills refit column swaps.
Ablation: multivariate obs alone (trivar MVN, homogeneous A). Isolates the observation channel.
Phase3 ablation: winner exp_004 minus NH (diag trivariate, homogeneous A). Does NH-VIX still earn with diagonal Sigma?
Ablation: NH transitions alone (drawdown-200 univariate, softmax(VIX) A). Isolates the transition.
Phase3 capstone: K=3 multivariate Student-t + NH-HMM softmax(VIX). COVID-cracker x fat-tail smoothness.
Phase3: K=3 multivariate Student-t (full Sigma, per-state nu), homogeneous A. Fat tails to crack COVID.
